The '''''Surveyor''-class reconnaissance frigate''' was an Imperial scout craft manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It was based on the [[Active-class fast attack frigate/Legends|''Active''-class fast attack frigate]], with a hull that resembled that of the [[Vindicator-class heavy cruiser|''Vindicator''-class heavy cruisers]], while the bridge and primary sensor arrays were in a structure resembling the bridge of a [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnought]].<ref name="LbE" />

The vessel carried both a full squadron of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and a decent armament for a craft its size, but its primary mission remained reconnaissance. To support these efforts the class was equipped with powerful sensors and signal interception systems along with a stealth system that aided in concealing the frigate's location even while active scanners were in use.<ref name="LbE" />

These vessels were most commonly deployed in Imperial Navy formations that were based in [[Core Worlds/Legends|The Core]] and [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] regions of the galaxy.<ref name="LbE" />
